## Father’s Day Around the World
The US date in June is now the most widely adopted, in part because American influence in the postwar years carried the holiday abroad.

# When Is Father's Day 2026? June 21 Guide
If you're planning something special for Father's Day this year, mark June 21 on your calendar. That's [when Father's Day 2026](https://welcome.storyworth.com/) lands in the United States, the third Sunday in June.

- Father's Day 2026 falls on June 21 in the USA, Canada, and the UK.

## When is Father's Day 2026 in the United States
In 2026, that means Father's Day lands on **June 21, 2026**.

### When does Father's Day start and end?
Father's Day in the United States is observed all day on June 21, 2026, from midnight to midnight in each local time zone.
